hooks.command: node -e "const c=[];process.stdin.on('data',d=>c.push(d));process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const d=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8'));const s=d.tool_input.content||d.tool_input.new_string||'';if(s.includes('\u2014')){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'Em-dash (U+2014) found. Em-dashes break PowerShell 5.1 parsing in files without a UTF-8 BOM. Replace with a hyphen or double-hyphen (--).'}}))}})"
